content.text: I will run a command to count distinct stock indices Bob sold but never bought.

arguments: {"script":"awk 'BEGIN{IGNORECASE=1} /Bob/ { if($0 ~ /\\<(sell|sold)\\>/) act=\"sell\"; else if($0 ~ /\\<(buy|bought)\\>/) act=\"buy\"; else act=\"\"; if(act){ idx=$(NF-1); if(act==\"sell\") sold[idx]=1; else if(act==\"buy\") bought[idx]=1 } } END{c=0; for(i in sold) if(!(i in bought)) c++; print c }' /usr/stock.log"}
